_meta.note: basicAttack.basePowerMilli is the base ActionBaseMath.BasePerHit multiplies by P(Theta) and divides by 1000 once: base(Theta) = basePowerMilli * P(Theta) / 1000. Calibrated so the basic attack reproduces the atk baseline it replaces at the golden actors own levels: BaseAtk(5)=30 / (P(5)=215 / 1000) = 139.5 -> 140. One scalar holds across the band (BaseAtk(20)/P(20)=135.3, BaseAtk(1)/P(1)=141.5) because the atk channel and the hp ladder are both projections of the same power curve; the goldens therefore move by the re-bless alone, not by a balance swing. Corrected at AE1.4: v1 held 44118, which divided a level-5 atk by P(20) and carried the quotient as per-mille a second time, making every hit about 1000x too large. v1 stays on disk for revert. See tasks/evidence-fragments/AE1.4.md.
